benefits: Full tuition fee for an international Master's programme at Uppsala University
No application fee for the scholarship application
Several Uppsala scholarships can be applied for in one form, but only one Uppsala University scholarship can be awarded
eligibility: You must be a citizen of a country outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland
You must demonstrate academic talent and show interest in being in an educational environment

You can only be awarded an Uppsala University Global Scholarship for a Master's programme at Uppsala University chosen as first priority (the programme ranked highest of the four programmes you can choose at University Admissions)
You must have applied for the Master's programme before the University Admissions deadline

You must meet the entry requirements for the Master's programme you applied for, and the application fee and your complete supporting documents must be received by University Admissions before the deadline

You must not be admitted to one of the seven excluded programmes, including the Joint Nordic Master's Programme in Environmental Law, Biology NABiS, Evolutionary Biology MEME, Implementation, Transformative Learning and Sustainability, Religion in Peace and Conflict, Transformative Game Design, and Turkic Studies
requirements: Apply to an international Master's programme at Uppsala University as your first priority at universityadmissions.se before the University Admissions deadline
Ensure the application fee and complete supporting documents are received by University Admissions before the deadline
Submit the separate online scholarship application during the scholarship application period
Write a motivational letter of no more than 350 words that reflects the eligibility criteria of the scholarship programme

Academic talent and an interest in being in an educational environment

Applicants who submit incomplete applications or do not apply on time will not be considered
coverage: Full tuition fee of the international Master's programme applied for
application_method: Apply for an international Master's programme at Uppsala University as first priority at universityadmissions.se and pay the application fee
Save the eight-digit personal application number issued by University Admissions
Submit the online scholarship application form during the scholarship application period, specifying which scholarship programme(s) you are applying for and your application number

official.application_route: Apply first to the Master's programme as first priority at universityadmissions.se by its deadline, then file the separate free online scholarship application with a 350-word motivational letter when the scholarship window opens (next round: early 2027)
official.citizenship_residency: You must be a citizen of a country outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland
official.international_eligibility: Yes - the scholarship is open specifically to citizens of countries outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland who are liable to pay tuition fees
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Any international Master's programme at Uppsala University, except students admitted to the Joint Nordic Master's Programme in Environmental Law, Master's Programme in Biology NABiS, Master's Programme in Evolutionary Biology MEME, Master's Programme in Implementation, Transformative Learning and Sustainability, Master's Programme in Religion in Peace and Conflict, Master's Programme in Transformative Game Design, and Master's Programme in Turkic Studies
official.description: The Uppsala University Global Scholarship, funded by the Swedish Council for Higher Education, covers the full tuition fee for an international Master's programme at Uppsala University for citizens of countries outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland, but does not cover living expenses. The scholarships are highly competitive, with only about 2% of applicants receiving one, and the number available varies from year to year.
official.program_type: Merit-based tuition fee scholarship for international fee-paying Master's students
official.english_requirement: For most programmes, English proficiency equivalent to Swedish English 6: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 with no section below 5.5, TOEFL iBT total 90 with 20 in writing, or Cambridge CAE or CPE. The Master's Programme in English requires the higher English 7 level, which generally cannot be met by a degree taught in English.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a two-deadline process: your Master's application at universityadmissions.se must be complete by its January deadline (16 October 2026 to 15 January 2027 for autumn 2027), and only then does the short scholarship window open in early 2027 (last year it ran 16 January to 2 February). The award is not a cash stipend - it waives the tuition of your programme, which uu.se publishes per programme at 49,500 to 90,000 SEK per semester, so you must self-fund living costs and prove that for your residence permit. With roughly a 2% success rate and no weight given to financial need, treat it as a merit-based top-up on a funding plan you can already afford without it.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Academically strong citizens of countries outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland who can cover living costs themselves and are willing to make an Uppsala Master's programme their first choice at University Admissions.
application_readiness_checklist: Rank your chosen Uppsala Master's programme first among the four choices at universityadmissions.se, since the scholarship can only attach to the first priority
Sit an English test in time for the January UAD deadline (IELTS 6.5 overall with no band below 5.5, or TOEFL iBT 90 with 20 in writing)
Get your transcript and degree certificate certified by your registrar's or Examinations Office - certifications from faculty members are not accepted
Draft the motivation letter against the published eligibility criteria and keep it inside 350 words
Record the eight-digit application number from universityadmissions.se before you open the scholarship form
Line up proof of living-cost funds for the Swedish Migration Agency even though tuition would be waived
common_rejection_risks: Uppsala ranked below another programme in the UAD application - the award can only attach to the first-priority choice
A late or incomplete universityadmissions.se application: late applicants are not eligible for the scholarship at all, even if admitted to the programme
Being admitted to one of the seven excluded programmes, such as MEME, NABiS, or Turkic Studies
A motivation letter over 350 words or too generic to reflect the eligibility criteria
Building the application around financial need, which is explicitly not a selection factor
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Living costs (housing, food, insurance, and travel to Sweden) since the scholarship waives tuition only, plus the University Admissions application fee.
document_audit: The scholarship form takes no uploads; everything except the in-form motivation letter must already be registered at universityadmissions.se
Conditional admission documents must be issued and certified by the Academic Registrar's Office or Examinations Office, not by individual staff
The English test must meet English 6 (IELTS 6.5 with no section below 5.5); the MA in English needs English 7 and an English-taught degree does not automatically satisfy it
The application fee and all supporting documents must reach University Admissions before the deadline, not merely be submitted on the day
alerts: The scholarship window is only about two weeks and opens after the UAD deadline, so check uu.se from early January 2027
Missing the UAD deadline ends scholarship eligibility even if you later apply for the programme
You may apply for several Uppsala scholarships but can be awarded only one
Only about 2% of applicants receive an award, so keep a parallel plan for living costs
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Complete the national application at universityadmissions.se first, then use the link published on the uu.se scholarship page to file the free online scholarship form with your 350-word letter during the window.
